<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions where a ketone and a C‑C triple bond are broken in the forward direction (i.e., they are lost in the product). This matches the described cycloaddition transformation. I will use the target molecule SMILES and specify the functional groups broken accordingly.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C-C triple bond"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
